e.summary_en: South Africa’s conduct regulator under section 57 of the Financial Sector Regulation Act (No. 9 of 2017): research and data documents, annual reports and fintech working-group reports
e.summary_hk: 依《金融部門監管法》（2017 年第 9 號）第 57 條設立的南非行為監管機構：研究與數據文檔、年報、金融科技工作組報告
e.body:
**FSCA（Financial Sector Conduct Authority，南非金融部门行为监管局）** 是**南非的金融市场行为监管机构**，也是本轮「南非」这一市场缺口的数据侧条目。可核实信息（HTTP 200 实测）：**首页 1.7MB**；**研究页 `/Researcher` 310KB**（纯文本约 66KB），其正文实测明确写出其法定定位——**FSCA「监管并监督南非金融机构的市场行为」，其任务是「提升并支持金融体系的效率与诚信、并保护金融消费者」，依据《金融部门监管法》（Financial Sector Regulation Act, No. 9 of 2017）第 57 条**。站点另实测可见 **年报入口 `/Annual-Reports`**，以及**研究与数据文档**（页面以 `/_api/cr3ad_researchanddatadocses(...)` 形式的文档接口链接呈现），首页还挂有**《SA Retail Banking Diagnostic Report》（南非零售银行诊断报告）**、**《Financial Markets Review》**、以及**首届政府间金融科技工作组（Intergovernmental FinTech Working Group）报告**等。

对 RIAA：**① 补上南非监管侧数据入口**——池内监管机构条目已覆盖美国（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]）、欧盟（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）、澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-mcp]]）、加拿大（[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]）、印度（[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[korea-ai-accountability]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、印尼（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]）、马来西亚（[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]）等，**南非此前为 0**；**② 定位差异值得注意**——FSCA 管的是**市场行为（conduct）**，而**审慎监管**已归南非央行（SARB）下设的 Prudential Authority（本次实测 `resbank.co.za` 相关路径返回 **404**，即该入口未按该路径访问到，故本词条只写 FSCA 侧）；**「审慎 vs 行为」的双峰监管结构**本身就是可与 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 对照的制度案例；**③** 对做**消费者保护、市场行为、金融科技监管**方向的学生，FSCA 的研究文档与金融科技工作组报告是新兴市场的直接材料；与 [[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]] 一类治理框架条目可并读；**④** 与同市场的 [[assa]]（专业团体）配对，构成「**南非：专业团体 + 监管机构**」两条腿。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与研究页正文**（含第 57 条法定任务原文）**及年报入口的存在**，**但未打开任何研究文档或年报**；**②** 研究文档链接以 `/_api/cr3ad_...` 形式出现，**属动态文档接口，深链稳定性未经长期验证**；**③** 我在探测中猜测的两个路径（`/Research-and-Data`、`/Pages/Research-and-Data.aspx`）**实测均 404**，故**不给出具体栏目路径**，只给可核实的研究页与年报入口；**④** 本站**不含保险市场统计数据集**（若需南非保险数据，需另找 Prudential Authority 或行业机构，本次未找到可核实入口，如实记录）。**核实说明**：首页（1.7MB）、`/Researcher`（310KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；`/Annual-Reports` 与若干 `/_api/...` 文档链接在首页实测可见；**两个猜测路径实测 404 并如实记录**；**未打开任何文档**。
e.body_en:
**FSCA (Financial Sector Conduct Authority)** is **South Africa’s financial-market conduct regulator**, and the data-side entry for this round’s South Africa market gap. Verifiable details (measured HTTP 200): **homepage 1.7MB**; the **research page `/Researcher`** is 310KB (about 66KB of text) and its body states the statutory position explicitly — **the FSCA "regulates and supervises the market conduct of financial institutions in South Africa", with a mandate "to enhance and support the efficiency and integrity of the financial system, and to protect financial customers", under section 57 of the Financial Sector Regulation Act (No. 9 of 2017)**. The site also shows an **annual reports entry `/Annual-Reports`** and **research and data documents** (presented through document links of the form `/_api/cr3ad_researchanddatadocses(...)`); its homepage also carries an **"SA Retail Banking Diagnostic Report"**, a **"Financial Markets Review"** and an **Inaugural Intergovernmental FinTech Working Group** report.

For RIAA: **① it fills the South African regulatory data entry point** — the corpus’s regulator entries already cover the US ([[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[naic-ai-oversight]]), the EU ([[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[aae-ai-act-position]]), Australia ([[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-mcp]]), Canada ([[osfi-canada-data]], [[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]), India ([[irdai-sbsr-regulations]], [[irdai-ai-governance]]), Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]], [[korea-ai-accountability]]), Singapore ([[mas-insurance-statistics]]), Indonesia ([[ojk-insurance-statistics]]) and Malaysia ([[bnm-insurance-takaful]]), while **South Africa was at zero**; **② the distinction in remit matters** — the FSCA handles **market conduct**, whereas **prudential supervision** sits with the Prudential Authority inside the South African Reserve Bank (the `resbank.co.za` path tried here returned **404**, so this entry documents only the FSCA side); that **twin-peaks structure of prudential versus conduct regulation** is itself an institutional case to compare with [[iais-icp]], [[insurance-europe]] and [[oecd-insurance-data]]; **③** for students working on **consumer protection, market conduct or fintech regulation**, the FSCA’s research documents and fintech working-group reports are direct emerging-market material, readable alongside governance-framework entries such as [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]] and [[frai]]; **④** paired with [[assa]] (the professional body) in the same market, it forms a "**South Africa: professional body plus regulator**" pair.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check reached the **homepage and research page body** (including the section 57 mandate text) **and the existence of the annual reports entry**, **but opened no research document or annual report**; **②** the research documents appear as `/_api/cr3ad_...` links, i.e. **a dynamic document interface whose deep-link stability was not verified over time**; **③** two paths I guessed (`/Research-and-Data`, `/Pages/Research-and-Data.aspx`) **both returned 404**, so **no specific section path is given** — only the verified research page and annual reports entry; **④** this site **carries no insurance market statistics dataset** (South African insurance data would require the Prudential Authority or an industry body, for which **no verifiable entry point was found in this check — recorded honestly**). **Verification note**: the homepage (1.7MB) and `/Researcher` (310KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their text read; `/Annual-Reports` and several `/_api/...` document links were observed on the homepage; **the two guessed paths returned 404 and are recorded as such**; **no document was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**FSCA（Financial Sector Conduct Authority，南非金融部門行為監管局）** 是**南非的金融市場行為監管機構**。可核實資訊（HTTP 200 實測）：**首頁 1.7MB**；**研究頁 `/Researcher` 310KB**（純文本約 66KB），正文實測明確寫出其法定定位——**FSCA「監管並監督南非金融機構的市場行為」，任務為「提升並支持金融體系的效率與誠信、並保護金融消費者」，依據《金融部門監管法》（No. 9 of 2017）第 57 條**。站點另實測可見**年報入口 `/Annual-Reports`**、**研究與數據文檔**（以 `/_api/cr3ad_researchanddatadocses(...)` 形式呈現），首頁還掛有**《SA Retail Banking Diagnostic Report》**、**《Financial Markets Review》**、**首屆政府間金融科技工作組報告**等。

對 RIAA：**① 補上南非監管側數據入口**——池內監管條目已覆蓋美（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]）、歐（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]）、澳（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]）、加（[[osfi-canada-data]]）、印（[[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]）、韓（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、新（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、印尼（[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]）、馬（[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]）等，**南非此前為 0**；**② 定位差異值得注意**——FSCA 管**市場行為**，**審慎監管**歸南非央行（SARB）下的 Prudential Authority（本次實測 `resbank.co.za` 相關路徑返回 **404**，故本詞條只寫 FSCA 側）；**「審慎 vs 行為」雙峰監管結構**本身是制度案例，可與 [[iais-icp]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]] 對照；**③** 對做**消費者保護、市場行為、金融科技監管**方向者可並讀 [[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]]；**④** 與同市場 [[assa]] 配成一對。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與研究頁正文**與**年報入口的存在**，**但未打開任何研究文檔或年報**；**②** 研究文檔鏈接為 `/_api/cr3ad_...` 動態接口，**深鏈穩定性未經長期驗證**；**③** 我猜測的兩個路徑**實測均 404**，故**不給出具體欄目路徑**；**④** 本站**不含保險市場統計數據集**（南非保險數據需另找 Prudential Authority 或行業機構，**本次未找到可核實入口，如實記錄**）。**核實說明**：首頁、`/Researcher` HTTP 200 實測並讀取正文；`/Annual-Reports` 與若干 `/_api/...` 鏈接在首頁實測可見；**兩個猜測路徑實測 404 並如實記錄**；**未打開任何文檔**。
